title: 1. Manufacturing General Manager
text:
Job Summary

Deligh Industries Inc is seeking an experienced, organized, and results-driven Manufacturing Project Manager to oversee manufacturing projects from planning through completion. The successful candidate will coordinate production activities, manage project timelines, monitor budgets, collaborate with engineering and operations teams, and ensure projects meet quality, productivity, and operational objectives.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan, coordinate, and oversee manufacturing projects from initiation to completion.
* Develop project schedules, milestones, budgets, and resource plans.
* Coordinate with production, engineering, procurement, and quality control teams.
* Monitor manufacturing project progress and ensure deadlines are met.
* Identify operational challenges and implement appropriate solutions.
* Track project expenses and support cost-control activities.
* Coordinate equipment purchases, materials, and production requirements.
* Monitor product quality and ensure compliance with established standards.
* Prepare project reports and provide progress updates to management.
* Organize project meetings and communicate responsibilities to team members.
* Evaluate project performance and recommend process improvements.
* Ensure project activities follow applicable workplace safety procedures.

Qualifications and Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* Previous experience in manufacturing, project management, or industrial operations.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and production workflows.
* Experience managing project schedules, budgets, and resources.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management software.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

Preferred Skills

* Manufacturing project management.
* Production planning and coordination.
* Budget monitoring and cost control.
* Quality assurance and process improvement.
* Resource and materials management.
* Cross-functional team leadership.
* Project reporting and performance analysis.

Work Environment

This position involves working in a manufacturing and industrial operations environment, combining office-based project planning with coordination on the production floor. The manager works closely with engineers, production supervisors, technicians, suppliers, and management personnel. Appropriate safety procedures must be followed when entering manufacturing areas.

Career Progression

With demonstrated performance and professional development, employees may pursue advancement into senior project management, manufacturing operations management, plant management, production director, or industrial operations leadership roles.

Benefits

Potential benefits may include paid time off, health coverage, retirement savings options, professional development, and other employment benefits, depending on company policy, employment status, location, and eligibility.

About the Company

Deligh Industries Inc is identified as the employer for this opportunity. Applicants should contact the company directly to confirm its manufacturing operations, project assignments, specific responsibilities, and employment details.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit an updated résumé highlighting relevant manufacturing, industrial operations, engineering, project management, or production coordination experience. Qualified applicants may be contacted for additional information and an interview.

Pay: $18.00 - $22.00 per year

Benefits:

* Relocation assistance

Work Location: In person
